module grades.scoring
  purpose: Convert scores to letter grades and analyze grade distributions.

public type Grade is one of
  purpose: A letter grade from A to F.
  A
  B
  C
  D
  F
end

public function score_to_grade(score: Integer) returns Grade
  purpose: Convert a numeric score to a letter grade using 90/80/70/60 cutoffs.
  example: score_to_grade(score: 95) is A
  example: score_to_grade(score: 85) is B
  example: score_to_grade(score: 75) is C
  example: score_to_grade(score: 65) is D
  example: score_to_grade(score: 55) is F

  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end
end

public function grade_distribution(scores: List of Integer)
  returns Map of Grade to Integer
  purpose: Count how many students received each grade.
  example: grade_distribution(scores: [95, 85, 75, 65, 55]) is {"A": 1, "B": 1, "C": 1, "D": 1, "F": 1}

  let grades be
    for each score in scores
    collect score_to_grade(score: score)

  let distribution be {}
  for each grade in [A, B, C, D, F]
    let count be
      for each g in grades
      where g is grade
      count
    set distribution to distribution.set(key: grade, value: count)
  end

  return distribution
end
```

module grades.scoring
  purpose: Convert scores to letter grades and analyze grade distributions.

public type Grade is one of
  purpose: A letter grade from A to F.
  A
  B
  C
  D
  F
end

public function score_to_grade(score: Integer) returns Grade
  purpose: Convert a numeric score to a letter grade using 90/80/70/60 cutoffs.
  example: score_to_grade(score: 95) is A
  example: score_to_grade(score: 85) is B
  example: score_to_grade(score: 75) is C
  example: score_to_grade(score: 65) is D
  example: score_to_grade(score: 55) is F

  if score is at least 90 then

  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then

public function grade_distribution(scores: List of Integer) returns Map of Grade to Integer
